newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Effect of further dlr rise on EU growth unclear - EU.
newsitem.headline: Effect of further dlr rise on EU growth unclear - EU.

text.p: European Monetary Affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said on Tuesday it was unclear what effect an even higher dollar would have on economic growth in the European Union.

"With the dollar at 1.75 deutschmarks, that is (a contribution of) around 0.3 to 0.4 percent (to gross domestic product growth) over three or so quarters...at 1.90 or 1.92 marks nobody knows what the effect would be," he said.
De Silguy said earlier the recent appreciation of the dollar could be positive for EU-wide growth this year.

Speaking to the European Parliament he confirmed a Commission prediction that EU growth would be around 2.3 percent in 1997. "At the same time we note that the appreciation of the dollar (over 10 percent above the 1996 average) constitutes a positive factor which could lead to raising this."
